opening.speech: Ferry's not running. Bell's not rung for two days and I'll not cross to a silent abbey.

choices.text: What do you think has happened?

guess.speech: I think the tide came in and did not go out. Go east to Ash Hollow and ask Rell — they watch the shore, and they'll have seen the water before I did.

long.speech: It is when the bell is the only clock forty people have. Ask Rell at Ash Hollow, east along the shore road.
